summaries.projects-site-keeper: Works on a client project in `projects/` without putting it at risk: backup, a clone to try the change on, its Webship-js suite, its addresses; starts a new project from a builder
summaries.projects-workflow: How work is done in `projects/`: back up, clone, test, clear the clone; every command with its flags, the settings keys
summaries.projects-clone: `/projects-clone <project> [new name] [folder]`: backs the project up, clones it and says where the clone answers
summaries.projects-backup-clone-and-test: A new session that backs a project up, clones it and runs the Webship-js suite on the clone
